text:
Maya: Hey team — we need a new GPU node pool in australia-southeast1 for the recommendation model experiments. Can we agree on instance flavor and autoscaler knobs?

Sahil: What’s the workload profile? small low-latency pods or large batch jobs?

Maya: Mostly batch evals + some interactive A/B tests. Typical pod requests: 4 vCPU, 30GB RAM, 1 GPU for evals; some long-running ray workers want 2–4 GPUs. Latency not super strict for the experiments.

Lin: If it's mostly batch, leaning toward A10G nodes (best cost/perf) — we can pack 4 x A10G per node (density helps). A100/H100 are great but $$$ and quota is tight in AU region.

Aditya: Agree on A10G. Also recommend tainting the pool so non-gpu workloads don't land: `kubectl taint nodes --all gpu=reserved:NoSchedule` on the pool. Use node labels for `gpu-type=a10g`.

Dena: Quick FYI, when I tried to create an A10G pool in australia-southeast1 earlier I hit quota: `ERROR: (gcloud.compute.quota) Some quotas are insufficient: [GPUS]` — we should request quota bump first. ops-bot can open the cloud ticket.

ops-bot: @channel created ticket CLOUD-7892 to request 40 additional GPUs in australia-southeast1. ETA from cloud provider: 24-48h.

Sahil: For autoscaler, min=0, max=10 nodes to start? If we do 4 GPUs/node that gives 40 GPUs max which should cover early experiments. Set `--balance-similar-node-groups=true` and `--scale-down-unneeded-time=10m` to avoid flapping.

k8s-autoscaler-bot: Recommended autoscaler args from past runs: `--scale-down-unneeded-time=10m --skip-nodes-with-local-storage=false --expander=least-waste` (past simulations showed 6-15% cost savings).

Maya: Nice. Can we also enable GPU preemption-friendly labels so batch jobs can be scheduled on preemptible/spot instances? Cost matters.

Aditya: Yes — create a second node pool `australia-a10g-spot` with `preemptible=true`, tainted as `gpu=spot:NoSchedule`, and use pod tolerations on batch jobs. Keep on-demand pool for ray head + latency-sensitive tasks.

Lin: Posting the create command I used (adapted):
```bash
gcloud container node-pools create australia-a10g-on --cluster=prod-au 
  --machine-type=n2-standard-16 
  --accelerator=type=nvidia-a10g,count=4 
  --num-nodes=1 
  --enable-autoscaling --min-nodes=0 --max-nodes=10 
  --node-labels=gpu-type=a10g,pool=on-demand 
  --node-taints=gpu=reserved:NoSchedule
```

Dena: After the quota bump lands, I’ll run the command and confirm. Also we should add resourceQuota / LimitRange in the dev namespace to avoid single pods hogging all GPUs.

Maya: Cost note — rough estimate: A10G nodes (4x) about $4.5/hr node => ~ $18/hr for 4 GPUs equivalent per node? (we should validate with billing). If we hit scale=10 that’s ~ $45/hr baseline when fully used.

Sahil: Can we add cluster-level placement policy so we prefer spreading pods across racks? We had previously hit noisy-neighbor GPU thermal throttling in AU. Use `topology.kubernetes.io/zone` anti-affinity.

Aditya: Good call. And ensure we export node metrics to console for per-node GPU utilization dashboards — helps Optimize recommendations later.

Maya: Great — plan: 1) wait for CLOUD-7892 quota bump, 2) create on-demand & spot A10G pools with taints/labels, 3) autoscaler args per k8s-autoscaler-bot, 4) add LimitRange/resourceQuota + anti-affinity. Dena, Sahil, can you take ownership?

Dena: I’ll follow up on the quota ticket and run the create once approved.

Sahil: I’ll prepare the autoscaler rollout and dashboard panels. Will post PR with Terraform config later today. :thumbsup:

Maya: Thanks — looping back once pools are active.
